task: Fix security/secrets/adversarial agent hallucinations. Root cause: (1) a BaseAgent.parseFindings Stage 4 bug mislabeled a complete bare object response as truncated, and (2) genuine LLM content hallucination, reproduced 9/9 across secrets/adversarial/dependencies. Fix: SecretsAgent/DependenciesAgent now call gitleaks/npm audit directly and skip the LLM entirely when available, eliminating the hallucination failure mode for those two agents; adversarial/secrets' LLM-fallback prompts were tightened (rate-reduction, not guaranteed -- adversarial showed no measurable improvement in the honest before/after measurement); ToolAvailability schema/formatter surfacing added for degraded-mode visibility. Also fixed a real Windows-only npm spawn bug (ENOENT, requires shell:true) found via live calibration, independent of the original plan.
